name: Clock
description: Show local time, a different time zone, or a clock for any location. Choose date style, language and 12- or 24-hour time.

displayName.title: Name in admin
displayName.description: Name this copy for its purpose, such as Lobby weather or Workshop energy. Its connection ID stays the same.

title.title: Display title
title.description: Default heading on the display. A screen panel can override it.

timeZone.title: Time zone
timeZone.description: IANA time zone, for example Europe/Madrid or America/New_York. Empty uses the shared display time zone.

compact.title: Compact layout
compact.description: Use the layout designed for small screens.

locale.title: Language and date locale
locale.description: For example en-GB, en-US, es-ES or de-DE. Empty uses the display language.

location.title: Location label
location.description: Optional label for this clock. Empty uses the screen’s location.

additionalClocks.title: Other time zones
additionalClocks.description: Optional world clocks for family, travel or distributed teams. Each includes its local date.
